name: atebites-plugins
description: atebites-hub plugin catalog for Grok Build: native-orchestration, ponytail, Advisor, j-space, superpowers, factory-policy (v1 warn-default; not a Factory default), and gitnexus (Upcoming / P N wrap; not a Factory default). Local path sources only.

plugins.name: native-orchestration
plugins.description: Skill-only guidance for host-native orchestration; replaces retired ODW without a workflow engine or MCP server.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: Advisor guidance for Grok Build: experimental detection; strict delegation disabled because hook failures are fail-open.

plugins.name: j-space
plugins.description: Inference-time workspace control for long-horizon work: selective loading, ledger at seams, named verification, and recovery.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques.

plugins.name: factory-policy
plugins.description: v1 warn-default; not a Factory default. Catalog-listed for pin install until QA fail-mode VERDICT.

plugins.name: gitnexus
plugins.description: Upcoming / P N wrap; not a Factory default. Catalog-listed for pin install. Pins gitnexus@1.6.7.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Pinned Impeccable 4.1.0 frontend design skill. Skill-only package; no automatic hooks or MCP server.
